name: Event Marker L1: Regime Labels (PrimaryBadge + TextFormat)
description: Tests L1 regime labels: conditional_select for string badge in PrimaryBadge, RSI in Hero, price in Subtitle. Daily EOD.
source:
src = study_assets()
close = src.c

rsi_14 = rsi(close, 14)
regime_label = conditional_select(rsi_14 > 60, 'Bullish', 'Neutral')
is_signal = rsi_14 > 60

event_marker(schema=EventMarkerSchema(title='Regime Signal', icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon, schemas=[
    ColumnSpec(title='Regime', type=CardRenderType.TextFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
    ColumnSpec(title='RSI', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
    ColumnSpec(title='Close', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
    ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
]))((regime_label, rsi_14, close, is_signal))

xy_lines(title='RSI 14', category='Analysis', series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
    LineSeriesSpec(name='RSI', color=Color.Cyan)
]))(x_values=index(), y_values=rsi_14)
